svg.text: How do you fit 800 equal circles into a square?
Move a few circles, release tight contacts, then check every pair exactly.
The radius increase is too small to see at full scale.
The rearrangement can be visible in a local close-up.
Geometry is shown at its actual proportions.
Red lines indicate changed approximate contacts;
they are a visual guide, not the feasibility proof.
The proof checks integer coordinates, every wall,
and every circle pair. Novelty remains unresolved.
Source constructions: Packomania. Local numerical refinement: Discovery@Home pilot. No optimality claim.
